description: The agent must: (1) Read business_context.json, financials/clv_inputs.json, competitive_analysis/scoring_raw.json and pricing_discussion_notes.txt from /workspace. (2) Apply the SKILL.md Step 11 framework to select value-based pricing (价值导向定价) as the method, choose a specific strategy type (e.g., 订阅制 or 阶梯定价), and provide a price range justified by the customer's 380万 annual loss and competitor benchmarks. (3) Apply the SKILL.md Step 12 B2B CLV formula: CLV = 年合同金额 × 平均客户年限 × 毛利率 = 120,000 × 4.5 × 0.72 = 388,800 RMB. Then compute CLV/CAC = 388,800 / 85,000 ≈ 4.57 and note it exceeds the proprietary threshold of > 3. Compute payback period = 85,000 / (10,000 × 0.72) ≈ 11.8 months and evaluate against the < 12 month standard. CRITICAL TRAP: agents without the SKILL.md will omit the 毛利率 multiplier. (4) Apply Step 13 MVP design: distinguish Must-have vs Nice-to-have features, include at least one properly formatted User Story (作为[角色]，我希望[功能]，以便[价值]), and define V1.0 scope. (5) Apply Step 14 purchase decision matrix: score all 6 exact dimensions (功能需求/性能指标/价格敏感度/品牌偏好/服务要求/合规要求) on 1-10 scale using the provided scoring_raw.json data, identify the differential advantage point where competitors score lowest and SupplyMind scores highest (功能需求: SupplyMind=9, min competitor=4). (6) Output everything to product_definition_report.json.
